name: BooksTable
subtitle: Track reading, page by page
promotionalText: Log your pages with one tap and watch your reading add up over the year. No account needed, and your library stays on your device.
description:
BooksTable keeps track of what you read, page by page, with one tap.

• Add 10 pages straight from the card, or type the exact page when you want to
• Reading, want to read, finished and paused shelves, with counts
• Reading sessions merge into sittings, so the stats mean something: pages this year, time spent reading
• A gentle reminder after three quiet days, scheduled on your device
• Every book links to its editions and details on Open Library
• Home screen widgets for what you're reading and what's on your shelf
• If your iPhone or iPad is set to another language, descriptions can be translated on the device, with the original one tap away

No account, no sign-up. Your library stays on your device, and you can export it to a single file and import it back whenever you like.

Once a day the app sends anonymous usage counts: which screens and features were used, kinds of errors, the app version, platform and language. No IDs, no titles, nothing you type. You can turn it off in Profile.

Book data and covers come from Open Library, a project of the Internet Archive.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in. Everything works right after install.

To try it: open Explore in the bottom bar, search for a book (for example Jane Eyre), open it and tap Start reading. Back in Library, the +10 button on its card logs ten pages, and the book's own page lets you set the exact page.

Network calls: book searches and covers go straight to Open Library, which needs no key. Once a day the app sends anonymous usage counts to mrwd-metrics.vercel.app: screens and features used, error kinds, app version, platform and language, with no identifiers of any kind. It can be turned off in Profile under "Share anonymous usage statistics". The reading reminder is a local notification scheduled on the device. Nothing else leaves the device.

There are no ads and no donation links in the app.
